title: Mark S NDE 6711/4922 NDE 4922
content:
6711 On a 2 lane, windy, country style roadway bordering the south side of the Bethpage State Golf Course (Quaker Meeting House Road) I was the front seat passenger in a 2003 Mercedes-Benz CL55 AMG. Don was driving and Wayne was sitting in the middle of the back seat hunched forward to speak to Don. Don just got off the phone in tears. As we turned a sharp uphill right hand bend Don leaned on the throttle initiating an automatic downshift into 516ftlbs of torque that lunged the vehicle into the oncoming lane. I became wide awake (I was sleeping a minute beforehand). Don recovered control before we reached the trees and while starting to turn back into our eastbound lane, a stretch limousine merged Westbound from the Golf Course exit road landing right in front of us. Both drivers braced on the accelerator pedals as neither nosed down. The CL55 downshifted once again this time lunging through the front end of the limousine. Don was braced with arms outward in anticipation of the airbag while I was able to predict the airbags will not timely deploy with that much acceleration applied and raised my left arm and leg to absorb impact energy. My left leg snapped in tension against the center console. Then Wayne nicked my left shoulder with his right shoulder in flight to the dashboard's center where he fractured his skull and died with brain damage 6 hours later. Then the inside of my left knee wedged into the dashboard recompressing my first left femur break and breaking again a few inches forward of the 1st break (in compression this time). The outside of my right knee sustained lacerations against the dashboard too (but no more femur breaks). Then my left forearm snapped against the dash and my head came down upon my left hand against the dashboard. That impact was just strong enough to expunge my spirit but not enough for any head injuries (just a bruised left hand for months from nearly being smashed). The veil felt so thin. I was on my feet, with no pain, as if just thrown forward. I landed like a child against the chest of his Father (with my head barely reaching the height of his chest). This spirit was broad, tall, long hair and had a love I have never and will never feel in this world. My fists landed first clinched in front of my head and I knew I had to return to a body in a vehicle that will soon be on fire. However, I wanted to stay so I pushed off saying, 'I'm not F'n done yet'. My mind relayed the reasoning and commitment, as if a third party, between my spirit and the other (without a word but telepathically). And with my push off, I felt that rubber band snap back into my body as if bouncing off the inside of my spine and traveling a lot further back than I did forward. The spirit was standing in front of a light source so all I saw was his outline. Once back inside my body, my first thought was to pull back for the coming delayed airbag deployment and just as my muscles tensed, the airbags deployed. The driver's airbag imposed a documented 10x14cm hemorrhage to his occipital scalp while my airbag picked my entire body up by my face and threw me backwards slamming the back of my head against the moon roof for a laceration requiring 10-staples to my occipital scalp. We were helped out of that burning vehicle and, as I sat on the side of the road knowing everyone else was/will die, I knew that was just the beginning and there will be no welcoming back committee. The past 7 years have been the most challenging of my life. I chose not to file claim against the driver's estate that had a wife and child left with a 1 million dollar insurance policy and about 400 thousand dollars in equity (700 thousand dollars' worth of injuries). I blamed myself, convincing myself I must have inadvertently slipped out of the seatbelt while raising my left limbs.

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: He reports being 'on my feet, with no pain, as if just thrown forward.'

arrival.other_being_detail: A 'spirit' described as 'broad, tall, long hair' with overwhelming love; seen only as an outline because it stood in front of a light source.

environment.environment_other_detail: No setting described beyond a light source behind the spirit; 'The veil felt so thin.'

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: He felt he 'had to return to a body in a vehicle that will soon be on fire' and said, 'I'm not F'n done yet'.
boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Felt like a 'rubber band snap back into my body as if bouncing off the inside of my spine'.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: High-speed car crash into a stretch limousine; vehicle later burning.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: No tunnel; immediate encounter with a loving 'spirit' and rapid return described as a rubber-band snap.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE/expulsion during impact → immediate encounter with a loving spirit in front of a light source with telepathic exchange → self-initiated push-off/return into body → airbags deploy and physical aftermath.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Return described mechanically as a 'rubber band snap back into my body' bouncing off the inside of his spine; he anticipated delayed airbag deployment upon return.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: 'The veil felt so thin.' 'I landed like a child against the chest of his Father.' 'I'm not F'n done yet'. '...felt that rubber band snap back into my body as if bouncing off the inside of my spine...'
